records.title: Ridge augmentation improves top-1 accuracy
records.abstract: Adding ridge augmentation raised top-1 accuracy by 2.1 points on the held-out split.

records.title: Learning-rate schedule and top-1 accuracy
records.abstract: A cosine learning-rate schedule changed top-1 accuracy by 1.4 points among the modelling choices we compared.
